### 2026-10-11 – This is my wonderful, amazing, and cute Starbie pet. It is shaped like a star, but it is a baby Yoda image. Starbie is a tiny motion-controlled digital pet: basically a desktop Tamagotchi with minimal

**6h**

This is my wonderful, amazing, and cute Starbie pet. It is shaped like a star, but it is a baby Yoda image. Starbie is a tiny motion-controlled digital pet: basically a desktop Tamagotchi with minimal gameplay buttons. Instead of pressing controls, you interact with it by physically moving the board.
